subject: The 2AM confession that built this feature
preview_text: I wasn't going to tell you this, but here's the real story behind SoulPlan's surprise date planner.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM. I was lying awake, staring at the ceiling, replaying the same argument with my partner: 'We never do anything fun anymore.' The truth stung. I had the best intentions, but between work and life, date planning kept slipping. That night, I opened a notes app and scribbled a wild idea—what if an app could plan a surprise date for your partner, so you never have to feel guilty again?

So I built it. Right there, in my pajamas, fueled by regret and a desperate need to fix something broken. The feature is called Surprise Date Planner. One partner picks a vibe, budget, and availability, and the app generates a complete secret plan. The other partner gets a notification: 'You have a date tonight. Dress casual, be ready at 7.' No spoilers, no stress, just magic.

Here's why I'm telling you this at 3PM instead of 2AM: because I've seen 230+ couples use this, and 92% say it saved their date night. But most users never even try it. They think it's too complicated or they'll mess it up. You won't. I promise. It takes 90 seconds to set up, and your partner will think you're a mind reader.

Open the app tonight and click 'Surprise Date Planner.' Pick something you'd never normally choose. Let the app do the heavy lifting. Then text me back and tell me how it went. P.S. If you're reading this on a Friday night and still haven't used it, I dare you to try it before midnight. Your relationship will thank you.
